call_rpc_read_action.title: Call a read-only RPC action
call_rpc_read_action.description: Call any RPC-style Alibaba Cloud API action that only reads, such as DescribeInstances or ListUsers, against the product endpoint set on this connection. The request is signed with ACS3-HMAC-SHA256 and sent as GET with every parameter in the query string. Use call_rpc_write_action for actions that create, change or delete.

action.description: The API action name exactly as Alibaba Cloud's reference spells it, e.g. DescribeInstances.

version.description: Override the API version for this call, e.g. 2014-05-26. Defaults to the version set on the connection.

params.description: The action's request parameters as a flat object of name to value, e.g. {"RegionId": "cn-hangzhou", "PageSize": 50}. Repeated-list parameters use their dotted names, e.g. "InstanceId.1".

output.description: The action's JSON response, including its RequestId.

call_rpc_write_action.title: Call an RPC action that changes state
call_rpc_write_action.description: Call any RPC-style Alibaba Cloud API action that creates, modifies, starts, stops or deletes resources, such as RunInstances or DeleteVSwitch. Sent as a signed POST with the parameters in the query string. Check the action's reference first: many writes are billed or irreversible.

action.description: The API action name exactly as Alibaba Cloud's reference spells it, e.g. DescribeInstances.

version.description: Override the API version for this call, e.g. 2014-05-26. Defaults to the version set on the connection.

params.description: The action's request parameters as a flat object of name to value, e.g. {"RegionId": "cn-hangzhou", "PageSize": 50}. Repeated-list parameters use their dotted names, e.g. "InstanceId.1".

output.description: The action's JSON response, including its RequestId.

call_roa_get.title: Call a ROA-style GET action
call_roa_get.description: Call a RESTful (ROA-style) Alibaba Cloud API action that reads, such as ACK's DescribeClustersV1 at GET /api/v1/clusters. Give the action name and its documented path; query parameters go in params.

action.description: The API action name exactly as Alibaba Cloud's reference spells it, e.g. DescribeInstances.

path.description: The action's request path from the API reference, e.g. /api/v1/clusters, with its path parameters already filled in.

version.description: Override the API version for this call, e.g. 2014-05-26. Defaults to the version set on the connection.

params.description: The action's request parameters as a flat object of name to value, e.g. {"RegionId": "cn-hangzhou", "PageSize": 50}. Repeated-list parameters use their dotted names, e.g. "InstanceId.1".

call_roa_post.title: Call a ROA-style POST action
call_roa_post.description: Call a RESTful (ROA-style) Alibaba Cloud API action that creates or triggers something, such as ACK's CreateCluster at POST /clusters, with a JSON body.

action.description: The API action name exactly as Alibaba Cloud's reference spells it, e.g. DescribeInstances.

path.description: The action's request path from the API reference, e.g. /api/v1/clusters, with its path parameters already filled in.

version.description: Override the API version for this call, e.g. 2014-05-26. Defaults to the version set on the connection.

params.description: The action's request parameters as a flat object of name to value, e.g. {"RegionId": "cn-hangzhou", "PageSize": 50}. Repeated-list parameters use their dotted names, e.g. "InstanceId.1".

body.description: The JSON request body the action documents.

call_roa_put.title: Call a ROA-style PUT action
call_roa_put.description: Call a RESTful (ROA-style) Alibaba Cloud API action that replaces or modifies a resource, such as ACK's ModifyCluster at PUT /api/v2/clusters/{ClusterId}, with a JSON body.

version.description: Override the API version for this call, e.g. 2014-05-26. Defaults to the version set on the connection.

params.description: The action's request parameters as a flat object of name to value, e.g. {"RegionId": "cn-hangzhou", "PageSize": 50}. Repeated-list parameters use their dotted names, e.g. "InstanceId.1".

body.description: The JSON request body the action documents.

call_roa_delete.description: Call a RESTful (ROA-style) Alibaba Cloud API action that deletes a resource, such as ACK's DeleteCluster at DELETE /clusters/{ClusterId}. Deletion is usually immediate and permanent.
